A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ViClaim work. Inspection supports comparison of the complete main text, Appendices A–F, seven tables, and five figures, including the image-based survey results.

before.justification: v2 reports original annotation-agreement measurements, cross-validation and leave-topic-out results, proprietary-model evaluations, and annotator-survey findings.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices, including Tables 2–4 and 7 and the survey figures.

M1.justification: The annotation process, MACE-weighted soft labels, transcript-plus-sentence inputs, cross-entropy objective, and fine-tuning/QLoRA procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same three languages, six topics, and sentence-level claim-detection tasks. Appendix F's written-versus-spoken evaluation coverage is also unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 3–4 retain Falcon, Llama, Mistral, and XLM-R comparisons. Table 7 retains the same three proprietary-model rows, and Appendix F retains its XLM-R and ModernBERT evaluations.

E3.justification: The stratified five-fold cross-validation, initial 15% test split, leave-topic-out design, early stopping, threshold selection, metrics, and Appendix A hyperparameters are unchanged.

E4.justification: The topic-transfer analysis, ambiguous-sentence cases in Appendix C, annotator-survey analysis in D, and written-versus-spoken comparison in F are retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Table 3 retains identical ± reporting, and Table 2 retains its agreement statistics. No seed information, repeated-run documentation, uncertainty estimates, or statistical tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: Section 4.2 changes reported XLM FCW/OPN scores from 0.896/0.848 to 0.899/0.836 and FNC leadership from L3B (0.777) to XLM (0.776), matching the unchanged Table 3. The abstract also changes 0.896 to 0.899. These are reporting corrections; the tables and appendix results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The weighted soft-label formula in Section 3.6 and formal data/input definitions in Section 4.1 are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The dataset, annotation-tool, and baseline contributions remain the same, as do the claims of strong cross-validation performance and difficult unseen-topic generalization. The abstract's numerical correction does not redefine these claims.

C2.justification: Explanations involving label prevalence, ambiguity, and domain differences are retained. Limitations concerning manual selection, annotation reliability, topic diversity, and transcript-only analysis are unchanged.

D1.justification: Corpus and code release instructions, transcription and segmentation tools, and Appendix A implementation details are unchanged, including the eight H200 GPUs and approximately 100 GPU hours.

R1.justification: Section 2, the cited works, and the bibliography are unchanged. The new funding acknowledgment does not revise the paper's research positioning.

P1.justification: v3 adds an acknowledgments section and makes targeted results-prose edits. Section 3.5 changes the questionnaire reference from Appendix D to F, although the relevant Exit Form Output section remains Appendix D. The broader organization is retained.

P2.justification: Tables 5 and 7 are smaller, and Table 7 loses its vertical cell borders. Reflow places Appendix F's final lines on an otherwise empty page 15 and shifts the unchanged survey figures one page later. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v3 improves reporting accuracy by aligning the abstract and Section 4.2 with Table 3, particularly correcting the FNC winner. This limited benefit outweighs the misleading questionnaire reference and awkward appendix pagination. The conclusion still reports 0.896, so the consistency correction remains incomplete.
